text:
amelia: quick heads-up — Acme wants guaranteed burst for launch next month: 100 qps sustained for 5m, plus spikes to 250 qps for 30s. They sign if we can commit to reserved pool + SLA. Thoughts?

devin: do we have capacity headroom on current pools? rough calc says yes if we reallocate one micro-pool. but impacts other pilots.

sanjay: can we satisfy w/o dedicated commit? maybe use soft-burst + prewarm credits. ops cost spike though.

claire: for launch criteria, we need: 1) perf regression <5% vs baseline, 2) latency p95 < 150ms during burst, 3) billing + quota UI updated, 4) playbook for preempt.

amelia: +1 on checklist. Customer insists on explicit acceptance criteria in contract. Can product commit to SLA numbers?

devin: propose phased scope: M1: reserved pool + autoscale config + smoke test; M2: SLA & billing; M3: UI self-serve. We can ship M1 in 3 sprints if eng-priority.

sanjay: risk: autoscale hysteresis. Suggest safe defaults:

```
cooldown: 60s
target_util: 0.7
spillover: true
```

claire: test plan: run chaos test + ramp to 300 qps with canary tenant. Add alert if p99 > 250ms.

amelia: ask from legal: need fallback if we miss SLA — automatic credits. Ops say that's fine.

devin: decision: ask eng leads to triage in next planning meeting. @sanjay can you draft perf test script and cost estimate?

sanjay: will do. ETA EOD tomorrow.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: perf-canary -> prod at 2026-05-05T14:00Z (ticket #4571).

claire: cool — flagging as high priority. adding to sprint board. :rocket:
